title: Micro-Luxury Spend by Mood Tag
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn
| search category="micro_luxury"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(amount) as spend count as purchases by _time mood_tag
| sort - _time
description: Tracks micro-luxury spending over time and breaks it out by mood tag.
value: Mood tags make it easier to see when the tiny luxury habit is comfort, celebration, or avoidance.
implementation: Send micro-luxury spending events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of micro-luxury spending by mood tag.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how micro-luxury spending changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
